title: Koszul-regular, H1-regular and quasi-regular immersions are fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the three properties of a morphism of being a Koszul-regular immersion, an H1-regular immersion and a quasi-regular immersion are fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6487-6496). The proof routes the three properties through the general criterion for fpqc locality on the base and discharges its three hypotheses one at a time: Zariski locality is read off from the definition of the notions in the divisors chapter, stability under flat base change is a cited lemma there, and the third hypothesis, which is the descent step, is first translated into an explicit algebra statement about a faithfully flat ring map A to B and an ideal of A whose extension is locally generated by a regular sequence, after which that statement is cited from the more-algebra chapter (proof lines 6498-6516). The claim is H2: the first two hypotheses are indeed cited, but the third is not merely cited -- the reduction of the geometric descent statement to the displayed algebra statement is carried out in the span and is the obligation a solver has to reproduce, and the citation then applies to that formulated statement rather than to the original one.
